description: Discover which matches have prediction-market odds coverage in the in-play odds tape (odds_ticks): per-match tick counts by source (polymarket = CLOB midpoint, apifootball = de-vigged bookmaker odds), in-play tick counts vs kickoff, capture span, live dataset totals (computed from the table, never hardcoded), and upcoming fixtures already mapped for capture. In-play odds are unbackfillable — a match that passed uncaptured stays uncovered. Use tokenintel_match_odds to fetch a covered match's probability curves.

days_ahead.description: Include upcoming mapped fixtures kicking off within N days (0-90, default 7). 0 disables the upcoming section.

days_back.description: Only matches with kickoff within the last N days (1-365). Default: all captured history.

token.description: Filter to one fan token's fixtures (e.g. PSG). Fixtures with no fan token are excluded when set.

name: tokenintel_odds_coverage
